name: Crisp stream fish
summary: Cá suối rán giòn is small stream fish fried until crisp, so the fine bones can be eaten too.
howToEat: Eat the fish whole, bones and all.
where: Anh Dũng on Xuân Viên lists cá suối on its menu.
seoTitle: Crisp stream fish in Sapa — fried whole
seoDescription: Cá suối rán giòn, small stream fish fried crisp enough to eat the bones, on Sa Pa menus.
